info.title: Foilbury
info.description: Local-first collectible-card cabinet. The browser, CLI and MCP server call the same authorised application commands. Use the Idempotency-Key header on money-like and destructive commands; reuse it for transport retries. Scoped Studio routes mirror the collection domain routes under /api/v1/studio and enforce the live Global Collection Admin or Bot role.

get.description: Returns environment, provider presence booleans and safe counts. No provider or deployment credentials are exposed.

get.summary: Inspect the eligible pool and actual odds
get.description: The returned entries are the actual eligible pool. Community policy and player preferences narrow it; the probabilities shown are recalculated from the narrowed pool. An empty pool never charges.

200.description: Pool preview with revision, price and probabilities

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

post.description: Available only when FOILBURY_LOCAL_MODE=true, FOILBURY_DEV_LOGIN=true and the request is on loopback. Revoke by setting FOILBURY_DEV_LOGIN=false.
Idempotency-Key is required. A retry with the same key and body returns the same receipt; changed input with the same key returns idempotency_conflict. A cooldown rejection does not credit.

post.summary: Draw a card from a reviewed pool revision
post.description: The server owns randomness. The expected revision, balance, pool eligibility and issuance are enforced in one D1 batch with triggers. A retry with the same idempotency key returns the original receipt and never rerolls.

200.description: Draw receipt with instance_id, serial, balance_after and random_commitment

post.description: Protects favourites and locked cards. The instance leaves ownership, history remains, and a recycle ledger entry credits the wallet.

post.summary: Create a reciprocal offer and reserve its cards

schema.description: Provide recipientId from the member directory or an explicitly supplied recipientEmail; recipientId takes precedence if both are present.

post.summary: Accept, decline or cancel a trade
Gift one card; a separate one-way transfer

get.summary: List card gifts sent by the current member
get.description: Requires trade:write for an agent. This is distinct from received administrative gift awards.

patch.summary: Edit a card with optimistic concurrency

delete.summary: Remove a draft or archive a collectible

200.description: Classes, categories, tags, rarities, materials and effects

patch.summary: Create a new draft pool revision
Update settings with a new version

post.description: No set-balance endpoint. The adjustment is a ledger entry; agent grants are bounded to 500 Foil per command.

post.summary: Create a scoped grant (human owner only)
Preview a source import without changing cards

200.description: Diff of new, revised and unchanged items

post.summary: Apply a source import as reviewable drafts

post.description: Validates card, edition, variant and render references before activation. It does not mutate wallets or issue cards.

get.summary: Operational counts, release and safe provider state

post.description: Never sends Discord or email. Local render/trade/gift receipts are marked delivered; external topics are suppressed for a future adapter.
Moves editions, variants, instances, tags, favourites, wishlists and set memberships to the target and records an alias. The source is retired, not deleted.

patch.summary: Update tenant publication and blocked topics
Enable or disable a topic policy

post.summary: Create a bounded generation plan without a billed call
post.description: The job remains planned unless an explicit ceiling and a verified adapter exist. No provider result is fabricated.
Refuses without a recorded ceiling and a verified adapter; no billed call is made by this build.

get.description: No token or private payload is exposed.

post.description: Rechecks current entitlement and sharing consent. A token never replaces membership authorisation.

200.description: Share URL, audience and captured preview

post.summary: Add or remove a wishlist card

get.description: Active peer directory for the current Bot. Requires inventory:read for an agent. Returns id, display_name and role; email and administrative data are excluded.

get.summary: List a member’s trade-eligible owned cards
Search people, platform roles and Bot memberships
get.description: Super Admin only. Returns explicit platform role scopes, Bot roles and pending invitations. Access admission is not a role.
Super Admin only. The Super Admin role itself is provisioned separately and is not granted here.

post.summary: Grant or change a scoped platform role idempotently
post.description: Super Admin only, recent strong authentication required. Only global_collection_admin is assignable; public showcase approval remains Super Admin-only.

403.description: Super Admin or strong authentication required

post.description: Super Admin only. Revocation is idempotent and never deletes the account, cards or history.

get.summary: List shared and Bot collections in scope
get.description: A Global Collection Admin sees only assigned shared collections plus their own Bot. Bot Admins see their Bot and enabled globals.

post.summary: Create a collection in the allowed scope
post.description: Public showcase approval remains Super Admin-only.

get.summary: Scoped Studio alias for collection management
get.description: Same domain service and live role checks as /api/v1/admin/collections, reachable by a normal signed-in scoped session rather than Cloudflare Access.

get.summary: Get one trade for a participating member
get.description: Requires trade:write for an agent; only the proposer or recipient can read the trade.

200.description: Trade detail including item and acceptance arrays

get.summary: List delivered gift awards for the current member and Bot
get.description: Requires trade:write for an agent; includes awards from platform campaigns targeted to this Bot.

get.summary: List Bot membership records for authorised operations
get.description: Requires a human owner or a member with content, economy or grants capability; agents require ops:read and an administrative represented role. Responses include email addresses.

200.description: Administrative member records including contact details

sessionCookie.name: fb_session
sessionCookie.description: Browser session cookie. Cookie-authenticated mutations also require x-foilbury-csrf.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Scoped to tenant, actor and operation. Same key + same body returns the stored receipt; changed input returns 409 idempotency_conflict.
